status: 255
No input file specified
Syntax: autofirma.jar sign [options...]

Options:
  -gui			 (Perform the operation with graphic environment. Priority over %0 !CommandLineLauncher.146!)
  -certgui		 (Use a graphic dialogue to select the signing certificate)
  -i inputfile		 (Input file path)
  -o outputfile		 (Output file path)
  -algorithm algo	 (Signing algorithm)
  	 sha1		 (Signature with SHA-1 fingerprint algorithm (Not recommended))
  	 sha256		 (Signing with SHA-256 fingerprint algorithm)
  	 sha384		 (Signature with fingerprint algorithm SHA-384)
  	 sha512		 (Signature with SHA-512 fingerprint algorithm (Default))
  -format		 (Sets the signature format)
  	 auto		 (Format selection based on input file)
  	 cades		 (Format CAdES)
  	 pades		 (Format PAdES)
  	 xades		 (Format XAdES)
  	 facturae	 (Electronic invoice signing)
  	 ooxml		 (OOXML format)
  	 odf		 (ODF format)
  -config extraParams	 (Properties in plain text with operation configuration)
  -store		 (Sets the store of keys. By default, the system)
  	 auto		 (Store system keys)
  	 windows	 (Store Windows Keys)
  	 mac		 (Store macOS keys)
  	 mozilla	 (Store Mozilla Firefox Keys)
  	 dni		 (Electronic ID)
  	 pkcs12:p12file	 (Store PKCS#12. "p12file" is the stock route)
  	 pkcs11:p11file	 (Store PKCS#11. "p11file" is the driver path)
  -password password	 (Sets the back of the store)
  -alias alias		 (Alias of signature certificate)
  -filter filter	 (Filter to select the signing certificate)
  -xml			 (Format the answer as XML)
